GOOD NEWS FOR UPSC IAS ASPIRANTS! 

Preparing for UPSC CSE and finding Indian Economy difficult? Here is an opportunity to strengthen your Economics fundamentals with an Economy Foundation Module available on YouTube.

This video highlights the FREE Economy Foundation learning opportunity for IAS aspirants who want to build conceptual clarity in Economy and prepare systematically for the Civil Services Examination.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM ECONOMY FOUNDATION PREPARATION:
✅ Indian Economy fundamentals for beginners
✅ Basic economic concepts and terminology
✅ Economy preparation for UPSC CSE Prelims
✅ Conceptual understanding for UPSC Mains GS Paper 3
✅ Foundation-level Economics learning
✅ A structured approach to understanding Economy
✅ Support for aspirants starting their UPSC preparation

• UPSC CSE 2027 and 2028 aspirants
• IAS and Civil Services Examination candidates
• Beginners who find Economics difficult
• Students looking for Economy foundation classes
• Aspirants preparing for GS Paper 3 and Economy-related Prelims questions

WHY IS ECONOMY FOUNDATION IMPORTANT?
Indian Economy is an important part of UPSC preparation. Understanding core concepts first can help aspirants approach topics such as inflation, banking, monetary policy, fiscal policy, GDP, poverty and economic development with greater clarity.

HOW TO MAKE THE MOST OF THIS OPPORTUNITY:
1. Start with the foundation lectures.
2. Make concise notes of important concepts.
3. Revise regularly and connect concepts with current affairs.
4. Practise UPSC previous-year questions after studying each topic.
5. Check the official YouTube channel for the complete lecture series and availability.

Don't let Economy become a barrier in your UPSC journey. Start with the basics and build your understanding step by step.

Dr. Rachita Luthra joins LevelUp IAS to answer common questions about posture, long sitting hours and discomfort during UPSC preparation. In this clip, she shares simple suggestions for managing discomfort when breaks are difficult.
